source.snippet: Why am I even thinking about company memory? Whenever we talk about AI brain for... [5 score, 2 comments, tags: ai, llm, softwaredevelopment, startup]

problem_statement: Small startups and solo operators lack a lightweight, persistent 'company memory' layer that lets AI assistants retain and reason over internal context — existing RAG and note tools require days of setup and break under real workloads.
target_segment: Solo founders and early-stage startup teams (1-10 people) using LLM tools for internal knowledge management
notes: Author built a working prototype in 3 days and published notes on what broke — signals a real recurring pain the author personally paid (time) to solve. Startup tag + software development context suggests a business buyer, but with only 5 points and 2 comments this is a weak independent signal. Buyer willingness: implied (time investment + active building). Watch for corroborating signals in ProductHunt/IH before promoting.
